title: 📱 News that shakes up the smartphone world!
body: 📱 News that shakes up the smartphone world!
New reports reveal that OpenAI has chosen Foxconn to assemble its first self-designed smartphone, aiming to produce thirty million units between 2027 and 2028.
The phone will run on a new MediaTek chip built on 2-nanometre technology, and will rely on AI for everything, from the camera to the voice assistant.
Simply put, the upcoming phone will not be just a screen and apps — it will be a smart assistant that understands you and talks to you.
Would you buy a phone designed by an AI company? And why?
